0022600209.text: The 11th-game-of-the-season Spurs visit the Suns with an 8-2 record, an eight-game winning streak, and a perfect 4-0 mark on the road, and they sit 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West. Phoenix is 3-5 and 12th in the West, 4.5 games back in the Pacific, and it has won its last two games. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and is a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (out, calf) and Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and the last meeting was a 101-100 Spurs win in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
